description: This file implements a RealtimeService class in Dart for Flutter that manages real-time communication via WebSocket with fallback to SSE. It supports subscription management, auto-reconnection with exponential backoff, JWT authorization, and message parsing. It is a core component for real-time updates in the attendance frontend project.

classes.name: _Backoff
classes.description: Helper class implementing exponential backoff with jitter for reconnection delays.

classes.name: RealtimeService
classes.description: Main class facilitating WebSocket and SSE connections with features like token-based auth, subscription management, auto-reconnect, and message parsing.

methods.name: withTokenGetter
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate RealtimeService with an external token getter function.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates connection, first attempting WebSocket, then falling back to SSE if WebSocket fails.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a topic/channel; sends a subscribe command over WebSocket or reloads SSE with new topics.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a topic/channel; sends an unsubscribe command over WebSocket or reconnects SSE accordingly.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes current connections and stops reconnection attempts.
